cn.t: Red Bull Theater tackles Shakespeare's notoriously bloody early tragedy with spirited boldness, earning mostly positive reviews. Critics praise the production's daring approach to the ultra-violent revenge tale, though some find the play itself more fascinating than satisfying.

vr.q: When a company like Red Bull does it with a cast that's this good in a space this intimate, you got to go. You don't wait. You go see it.
if you have the opportunity and if you think you can handle the blood and gore I would recommend it
